brief:
Settlers attacked vehicles on the road connecting Ramallah and Nablus, according to Shehab Wire. The assault took place on the main thoroughfare linking the two Palestinian cities in the central West Bank.

The attackers targeted multiple vehicles traveling the route. No immediate reports specified the number of vehicles hit, injuries sustained, or the extent of damage caused in the incident. The attack underscores ongoing tensions on Palestinian roads in areas where Israeli settlements are located near major transit corridors.
